items.prompt: A query supplies p=0.6 and b=1. Which statement about p is justified by running this formula?

options.text: The output independently verifies a true win frequency of 60%.
options.why: The function has no observations from which to estimate or validate a frequency.

options.text: The payoff odds force p to be 0.5.
options.why: Payoff size alone does not determine the supplied win probability.

options.text: A positive fraction proves p was calibrated correctly.
options.why: The output follows from p; it is not independent evidence for p.

options.text: p is assumed, not learned here.
options.why: The routine computes from its inputs and performs no probability calibration.

items.explanation: The routine computes from its inputs and performs no probability calibration.
